cache_format: Apache Parquet 2.6 with strict Pydantic revalidation
invalidation_policy: Any raw, adapter, validator, confirmed mapping, canonical schema, or cache-format identity change produces a miss; stale, incompatible, corrupt, or symlinked entries are never used.
publication_policy: Only accepted validation results are written to a private temporary directory, checksummed, verified, and atomically renamed. Existing entries are not rewritten.
raw_evidence_policy: Cache roots must remain outside directory bundles. Every lookup reopens and fingerprints raw evidence; cached files never replace or modify it.
